name: States
description: Logic controller that enables/disables other plugins based on hover attributes. The plugin names listed in `default` and `states` must match the registered `plugin.name` values you use in your app.

options.name: default
options.description: List of plugin names active by default.

options.name: states
options.description: Map of state names to lists of active plugins.

options.name: attribute
options.description: DOM attribute to trigger state changes.
